title_en: A Girl Fell Asleep by a Clear Spring
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear; reads like a newer folk-style song but I cannot name an author. 'Ем говори' is my reading as 'and speaks'; 'оздол'' = from below.

lines.en: A girl fell asleep by a clear spring,

lines.cyr: оздол' иде момче, па си води коњче,
lines.lat: ozdol' ide momče, pa si vodi konjče,
lines.en: a lad comes from below, leading his little horse,

lines.cyr: па си води коњче, право на изворче.
lines.lat: pa si vodi konjče, pravo na izvorče.
lines.en: leading his little horse, straight to the spring.

lines.cyr: Па се чуди момче как' да ја разбуди,
lines.lat: Pa se čudi momče kak' da ja razbudi,
lines.en: The lad wonders how to wake her,

lines.cyr: па си зеде кавал, с' кавал да засвири,
lines.lat: pa si zede kaval, s' kaval da zasviri,
lines.en: so he takes his kaval, to play on the kaval,

lines.cyr: с' кавал да засвири, моме да разбуди.
lines.lat: s' kaval da zasviri, mome da razbudi.
lines.en: to play on the kaval, to wake the girl.

lines.cyr: Колку кавал свири, моме се успива,
lines.lat: Kolku kaval sviri, mome se uspiva,
lines.en: As the kaval plays, the girl sleeps on,

lines.cyr: моме се успива и се поднасмева,
lines.lat: mome se uspiva i se podnasmeva,
lines.en: the girl sleeps on and smiles a little,

lines.cyr: па се чуди момче как' да ја разбуди.
lines.lat: pa se čudi momče kak' da ja razbudi.
lines.en: so the lad wonders how to wake her.

lines.cyr: Кротко се приближи, милно ја прегрна,
lines.lat: Krotko se približi, milno ja pregrna,
lines.en: Gently he came close, tenderly embraced her,

lines.cyr: милно ја прегрна, слатко ја целива,
lines.lat: milno ja pregrna, slatko ja celiva,
lines.en: tenderly embraced her, sweetly kissed her,

lines.cyr: моме се разбуди и му се налути.
lines.lat: mome se razbudi i mu se naluti.
lines.en: the girl woke up and got angry with him.

lines.cyr: - Зошто ме целувна, од сон ме разбуди?
lines.lat: - Zošto me celuvna, od son me razbudi?
lines.en: - Why did you kiss me, why did you wake me from sleep?

lines.cyr: Што бев слатко спала, теб' сум сонувала.
lines.lat: Što bev slatko spala, teb' sum sonuvala.
lines.en: I was sleeping so sweetly, I was dreaming of you.

lines.cyr: теб' сум сонувала, с' теб' сум се венчала.
lines.lat: teb' sum sonuvala, s' teb' sum se venčala.
lines.en: I was dreaming of you, I was married to you.

lines.cyr: Момчето ѝ вели, вели, ем говори:
lines.lat: Momčeto ì veli, veli, em govori:
lines.en: The lad says to her, says, and speaks:

lines.cyr: - Подобро би било на јаве да било,
lines.lat: - Podobro bi bilo na jave da bilo,
lines.en: - It would be better if it had been real,

lines.cyr: подобро би било, на јаве да било.
lines.lat: podobro bi bilo, na jave da bilo.
lines.en: it would be better, if it had been real.
